# Ocean Codex

Ocean Codex includes sign-in, models and quota. Search, images, voice, remote control, connectors and runtime installation are unavailable in this build. Connecting uses OpenAI subscription services; this community integration is not endorsed by OpenAI.

[Ocean](https://github.com/Ryltsevmg/Ocean-Chat) · [Upstream source (MIT)](https://github.com/WSL043/dsh-codex-subscription)
